ranking_scope: Same-domain same-target known positive versus negative pairs from original verified TRAIN full photos within a minibatch. Unknown labels and TRAIN crops excluded. No new labels, photo source, segmentation truth or inference output.
ranking_formula: Mean softplus(negative_logit-positive_logit) in each contributing domain-target group, then equal group mean, float32. No pairs yields differentiable zero.
source_selection: Unchanged core TRAIN manifest, sampler, source/full-crop mass and photo/pixel/auxiliary class weights. ConViD/PECCD/S2DS not added in this experiment.
epoch_selection: Same existing minimax per-target FNR/FPR on all three source validation domains, then sum of error rates; full-photo grid1 only.
strict_target: Every crack/spalling source validation FNR and FPR must be strictly below 0.05. The maximum is not the whole-app wrong-photo fraction.
source_test_policy: Do not infer on test unless the frozen validation strict target is met. Previously inspected source holdouts are not a fresh industrial field guarantee.
deployment: No automatic app profile/model replacement in this research experiment. A research gate pass alone is insufficient for app deployment.
interval_policy: Wilson two-sided 95% binomial intervals per observed FNR/FPR; descriptive only. Correlated photos and repeated epoch/threshold selection invalidate an independent confirmatory interpretation.
stop: Complete this one six-epoch pair; do not automatically retry recipes or extend epochs based on its validation result. No 5% guarantee.
training_outcome: Not yet measured when this protocol was declared.
